name: golden-hour-blonde-baddie
image_purpose: Create an inviting luxury-lifestyle selfie with warm light, detailed hair and polished lounge styling.

prompt.project_info: Hyper-realistic close-up smartphone selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original woman with voluminous blonde blowout hair and curtain bangs, bright blue eyes, natural sun-kissed skin with light freckles, glossy pink lips and confident relaxed eye contact; wearing a pastel baby-pink ribbed lounge set with a modest cropped zip hoodie and matching high-waisted pants.
prompt.composition_elements: High three-quarter close-up selfie angle; subject seated and leaning slightly toward the camera, one hand running through her hair, cream textured wall and rust-orange sofa behind her, coffee table with generic tumbler, snack bag and cards, blurred window with sheer curtains and a tall indoor plant in the distance.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunlight from the left creates a soft hair halo, balanced by cool ambient room fill; confident, relaxed and polished lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 24mm front-camera simulation or equivalent, hyper-realistic 8K UHD, detailed hair strands, knit texture, eye catchlights and natural pores, warm vibrant grading with a slightly subdued background.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic close-up smartphone selfie of a clearly adult original blonde woman with curtain bangs, blue eyes, light freckles and glossy pink lips, wearing a pastel baby-pink ribbed lounge set with a modest cropped zip hoodie, leaning toward the camera in a modern apartment, warm golden-hour side light, rust-orange sofa, cream wall, blurred window and indoor plant, detailed natural texture and polished lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, exposed cleavage, logos, text, watermark, distorted face, extra fingers, plastic skin, harsh blur
